criteria.name: Introduction and Problem Statement
criteria.description: The introduction should clearly explain the background, problem statement, and context of the research.

criteria.name: Literature Review
criteria.description: The literature review should critically discuss relevant prior work and identify key findings.

criteria.name: Research Gap
criteria.description: The report should clearly identify the research gap and justify the need for the proposed work.

criteria.name: Methodology
criteria.description: The methodology should describe the methods, models, tools, and procedures in sufficient detail.

criteria.name: SMART Objectives
criteria.description: The objectives should be specific, measurable, achievable, realistic, and time-bound.

criteria.name: Academic Writing and References
criteria.description: The report should use clear academic writing, proper structure, and sufficient references.
